notes: Published-line 0.4.2 is a patch on 0.4.1. A verbatim data policy applies only the profile's credential and exact-local-secret rules, as the server contract does, so permitted customer content such as email addresses and phone numbers is uploaded unmasked while credentials and local secrets stay masked; minimized handling still applies every rule (AUG-417). run report counts a truncated reply excerpt as complete evidence: MAPPED_RESPONSE_TRUNCATED and CRITERION_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED stay in diagnostics with retryable false and a stderr warning, the excerpt is not compared with the full-reply sha256, and a finished run exits 0 or 10 instead of 11; pending grading and missing or purged evidence still exit 11 (AUG-418). It keeps the 0.4.1 fixes: real-data runs against connector-verified private targets (AUG-399), saved real-data suite scopes read from the server's revision (AUG-402), re-sending a saved completion after a hard kill and releasing a finished run (AUG-404), relay poll and status retries until the run deadline, journaled skipped_sequences and run_id in runner, test and recover --json errors (AUG-412), a five-minute cleanup wait for cancelled runs (AUG-405), finished partial evaluations and no-reply attempts that exit 10 (AUG-403), and email and phone redaction across every reply text field with international phone matching (AUG-400). It keeps the 0.4.0 Node.js 22.12 minimum (engines.node >=22.12; Node.js 20 reached end of life in April 2026, and npm 0.3.9 stays the last version for Node.js 20) and hosted authorized real-data testing: target add, target verify, target list, target pull, and scope create register and verify a workspace target and write its test scope into an aw-suite/3 file, and authorized hosted runs quote and create with the scope's registered boundary hash after checking augmentworks.yaml against that boundary. It reads the server's real-data documents as aw-real-data/1 defines them, vendored from main 16d767967c9d000b81f10ddb09800b0273277b68 with releaseEnabled and runtimeEnforced true. gate reads the server's aw-release-gate-read/1 decision, compare reads aw-semantic-comparison-read/1, test and run wait take pass or fail from the graded run report, baseline promote sends runId, and baseline create makes a workspace's first pin. It also keeps the 0.3.9 hosted run-scope lookup hardening (AUG-335), the 0.3.8 report consistency check (AUG-272), and the saved-suite customer path: native aw-customer-suite/1 upload translation, saved-suite v2 binding, authoritative v2 whole-suite gate receipts, durable execution IDs, cross-shard quote/run uniqueness, and non-destructive generated .env guidance. Generated and documented npx commands pin this package version (0.4.2). published_package_verified is published-line identity (not a candidate), not a live registry probe of this exact tarball.
